calls.reason: No evidence tests whether users can predict GPT-5's successes in advance. OpenAI's 89% figure only shows that errors happen, and ORCFLO's high run-to-run consistency points the other way without measuring prediction.
The only item is a Microsoft demo of SQL and Python tool calling, with no reliability measurement. Nothing tests free-form natural-language output driving downstream programs directly.

An independent eight-benchmark study (Aug 2025) found GPT-5 below human level in several basic spatial abilities despite some human-level results. Nothing in the packet suggests the original GPT-5 is general-purpose AGI.
The condition has not been met. The AGI Society review (Sept 2026) finds no established trustworthy AGI, so the system's architecture cannot be checked yet.
